title: Trauma‑Informed Client Engagement
description: This module strengthens practitioner capability in engaging clients using trauma‑informed, strengths‑based, and culturally safe approaches. It focuses on building trust, working with resistance, and supporting clients who may be overwhelmed, fearful, or ambivalent.
outcomes: Recognise and respond safely to resistance and ambivalence
Use strengths‑based approaches to support client empowerment
